abstract.t:
Message size limits mean that large files are sent by email as links to a web server rather than as attachments. A link loses the properties that make an attachment useful: it can stop working, the file behind it can change, it can't be scanned in transit, and it may need a separate login.
This document defines the "Content-External" header field, which lets receiving systems fetch, verify and keep a linked file, and then treat it like any other attachment. The field is on a body part with a fallback link, which aware clients hide.
